support.guide1Body:
ToSche creates a daily workspace where you can organize and complete todos.
Start by adding tasks in the Workspace, and set reminders as needed.
support.guide2Body:
• A new page is created each day; swipe left or right to navigate.
• In 4-grid mode, organize tasks into areas.
• Checking a task records it as complete and feeds into Stats.
support.guide3Body:
Enabling "Task Reminder Sync" in Settings will mirror todos with reminders to your Schedule.
If you turn the sync off, schedules that were already created are not deleted automatically.
support.guide4Body:
Data is saved and updated based on your actions.
For safety, important actions (such as deleting all data) require a confirmation dialog.
support.guide5Body:
This app is for task-management support only; it is not a substitute for professional advice (medical, legal, tax, etc.).
Display or sync delays may occur due to device failure, network issues, or third-party service outages.
support.faq1Q: Q. Where is my data stored?
support.faq1A: A. Your todos and settings are stored on the cloud infrastructure used by the app. Login info and notification info are also managed only as needed to provide the service.
support.faq2Q: Q. Can deleted data be recovered?
support.faq2A: A. Recovery may not be possible depending on the situation. We recommend exporting important data regularly.
support.faq3Q: Q. What if notifications don't arrive?
support.faq3A: A. Please check your device's notification settings, app notification permission, network status, and battery optimization settings.
support.faq4Q: Q. May the service become temporarily unavailable?
support.faq4A: A. The service may be temporarily unavailable due to maintenance, network issues, or third-party service outages. We work to restore it as quickly as possible.
support.faq5Q: Q. How are pricing and refunds handled?
support.faq5A: A. If we add paid features, the purchase screen or separate terms will clearly state pricing, renewal, cancellation, and refund conditions. We do not operate in violation of consumer protection laws.
support.faq6Q: Q. What about liability for incidents or damages?
support.faq6A: A. We bear responsibility in accordance with applicable laws. Except in cases of our willful misconduct or gross negligence, our response is based on the scope of damages ordinarily anticipated.
support.faq7Q: Q. How can I contact support?
support.faq7A: A. Please reach out via the in-app support links. We'll review and respond in turn.

To use ToSche, you must agree to the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy below. Please review them and check the boxes.
